messages:
matt: Triage summary: saw 7 warmup fallback incidents across Dedicated in the last 5 weeks. I clustered them into 3 repeat signatures and sketched an action queue with owners/timelines. Need quick ack so we can seed the sprint.

julia: paste the signatures + one log snippet please.

matt: signatures:
- modprobe/udev timeout during GPU init -> warmup abort
- driver/firmware mismatch -> NVRM Xid / kernel panic -> reboot loop
- orchestration race: pod eviction while shard-fetch in progress

example:
```
[2026-04-12T08:11:05Z] warmup: pulling shard 3/12
[2026-04-12T08:11:08Z] error: modprobe nvidia_uvm returned exit 127
[2026-04-12T08:11:09Z] node-agent: warmup timed out -> evicting pod
```

omar: looks correlated with vendor rollouts on 2026-03-18 and 2026-03-28. agree on splitting infra vs orchestration fixes.

sre-bot: [ALERT] 1972000301 warmup_recurrence_detected pool:redwood-dedicated-usw-04 (4 failures in 48h)

matt: Action queue (short-term, 48h):
- omar: targeted rollback for nodes with kernel oops (owner: omar) — due 2026-04-14 EOD
- julia: add single retry + 4s backoff to modprobe step behind FF, instrument retry_count (owner: julia) — due 2026-04-14 noon
- anya: temporary routing weight away from pools with >2 failures (owner: anya) — due 2026-04-14 EOD

longer-term (2-5 weeks):
- infra: enforce AMI/firmware pinning and rollout gating (owner: omar + infra) — due 2026-05-01
- runtime: implement warmup lease to prevent eviction during shard download (owner: julia) — due 2026-04-28
- obs: warmup-recurrence dashboard + weekly digest (owner: anya) — due 2026-04-20
- process: add recurrence_count and recurrence_tag fields to postmortem template (owner: kevin) — due 2026-04-18

anya: ack, will stage routing changes in staging and monitor fallback_rate.

omar: creating ticket RCT-8010 and scheduling rollback window 2026-04-14 02:00 UTC. Will include smoke tests.

kevin: please add a recurrence_tag to RCT-8010 and link historical incidents. we want the ticket to surface in the weekly digest.

[~2h later]

omar: rollback complete for targeted hosts in usw-04. warmup success on those hosts improved from 71% -> 96% within 45m. attached logs to RCT-8010.

julia: modprobe retry PR landed in staging behind FF; canary shows ~40% reduction in transient failures so far.

anya: staging routing weight change reduced fallbacks in smoke tests by ~25%. will prepare gradual prod ramp.

matt: next steps: owners update RCT-8010 with runbooks, verification steps, and expected close dates. we'll re-evaluate recurrence in 2 weeks and either close or escalate to a reliability epic. thanks all. :handshake:
